findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Remote-to-file path traversal
 * @description Untrusted JSON instance values flowing into filesystem operations (path traversal risk)
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jsonschema-remote-to-file-path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module RemoteToFileConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(FileSystemAccess fa | sink = fa.getAPathArgument())
  }
}

module RemoteToFileFlow = TaintTracking::Global<RemoteToFileConfig>;
import RemoteToFileFlow::PathGraph

from RemoteToFileFlow::PathNode source, RemoteToFileFlow::PathNode sink
where RemoteToFileFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "User-controlled data reaches file path $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Untrusted JSON data might reach filesystem APIs leading to path traversal

message.text: User-controlled data reaches file path [user input](1).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Direct filesystem access in jsonschema package
 * @description Locate filesystem access (open, tempfile, pathlib) which may be influenced by untrusted schemas/instances
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jsonschema-fs-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall()
  or call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "mkdir", "makedirs", "rmdir", "remove", "unlink"]).getACall()
  or call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["NamedTemporaryFile", "mkstemp", "mkdtemp", "TemporaryDirectory"]).getACall()
select call, "Filesystem-related call inside jsonschema package."
findings.hypothesis: Find all filesystem usage inside jsonschema to assess risk of path traversal or unsafe file writes.
